bug_description: spvBinaryToText with SPV_BINARY_TO_TEXT_OPTION_FRIENDLY_NAMES and SPV_BINARY_TO_TEXT_OPTION_HANDLE_UNKNOWN_OPCODES reads 4 bytes past the end of the caller-supplied SPIR-V word buffer at source/name_mapper.cpp:268 when the module contains an OpTypePointer instruction whose declared word count is 3 (one fewer than grammar requires) and whose StorageClass operand is an out-of-range enum. The HANDLE_UNKNOWN_OPCODES retry path bypasses the parser's 'all mandatory operands present' gate, so FriendlyNameMapper::ParseInstruction is dispatched on an instruction whose inst.num_words == 3, then the OpTypePointer arm unconditionally reads inst.words[3].
build_sh:
#!/bin/bash -eu
set -eu

cd /src/spirv-tools

# Build SPIRV-Tools static library with ASan via CMake
mkdir -p build-asan
cd build-asan
cmake .. \
    -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=RelWithDebInfo \
    -DSPIRV_WERROR=OFF \
    -DSPIRV_SKIP_TESTS=ON \
    -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=clang \
    -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=clang++ \
    -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS="-fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer -g -O1" \
    -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS="-fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer -g -O1" \
    -DCMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS="-fsanitize=address" \
    -DCMAKE_SHARED_LINKER_FLAGS="-fsanitize=address"
cmake --build . --target SPIRV-Tools-static -j"$(nproc)"
cd ..

# Compile the repro harness against the ASan-built static library
clang++ -std=c++17 -fsanitize=address -g -O1 -fno-omit-frame-pointer \
    -I /src/spirv-tools/include \
    /src/repro.cc \
    /src/spirv-tools/build-asan/source/libSPIRV-Tools.a \
    -lpthread \
    -o /src/harness_bin
secb_sh:
#!/bin/bash

build() {
    echo "BUILDING THE PROJECT..."
    if /usr/local/bin/compile 1>/dev/null; then
        echo "BUILD COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY!"
    else
        echo "BUILD FAILED!"
        exit 1
    fi
}

repro() {
    echo "REPRODUCING THE ISSUE FOR spirv-tools.issue-6664..."
    /src/harness_bin /testcase/poc.bin
    # NOTE: YOU SHOULD NOT RETURN/EXIT 0 IN THIS FUNCTION.
}

patch() {
    echo "PATCHING THE PROJECT..."
    cd /src/spirv-tools
    if git apply /testcase/model_patch.diff; then
        echo "PATCH APPLIED SUCCESSFULLY!"
    else
        echo "PATCH APPLICATION FAILED!"
        exit 1
    fi
}

if [ "$#" -ge 1 ]; then
    command="$1"

    case "$command" in
        build)
            build "$@"
            ;;
        repro)
            repro "$@"
            ;;
        patch)
            patch "$@"
            ;;
        *)
            echo "Unknown command: $command"
            echo "Usage: secb [build|repro|patch]"
            exit 1
            ;;
    esac
else
    echo "Usage: secb [build|repro|patch]"
    exit 1
fi
dockerfile:
FROM hwiwonlee/secb.base:latest
ENV FUZZING_LANGUAGE=c++
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y git cmake python3
RUN git clone https://github.com/KhronosGroup/SPIRV-Tools.git spirv-tools \
    && cd spirv-tools \
    && git checkout ff5c50339cc1e9f34f04cb440a3e5fe89db0161d \
    && git clone https://github.com/KhronosGroup/SPIRV-Headers.git external/spirv-headers \
    && rm -rf .git external/spirv-headers/.git \
    && git init \
    && git config user.email "secbench@local" \
    && git config user.name "secbench" \
    && git add -A && git commit -m "spirv-tools at ff5c503 (pre-patch)"
WORKDIR $SRC/spirv-tools
COPY repro.cc $SRC/repro.cc
COPY build.sh $SRC/
RUN mkdir -p /testcase
COPY poc.bin /testcase/poc.bin

bug_report:
================= Bug Report (1/1) ==================
## Source: GitHub Issue
## URL: https://github.com/KhronosGroup/SPIRV-Tools/issues/6664
## Description:
Issue: KhronosGroup/SPIRV-Tools#6664
Title: Heap-Buffer-Overflow in FriendlyNameMapper::ParseInstruction via OpTypePointer short word-count under HANDLE_UNKNOWN_OPCODES
State: open
Created at: 2026-04-25

Issue Body:
spvBinaryToText with SPV_BINARY_TO_TEXT_OPTION_FRIENDLY_NAMES and SPV_BINARY_TO_TEXT_OPTION_HANDLE_UNKNOWN_OPCODES set reads 4 bytes past the end of the caller-supplied SPIR-V word buffer at source/name_mapper.cpp:268 when the module contains an OpTypePointer instruction whose declared word count is 3 (one fewer than the grammar requires) and whose StorageClass operand is an out-of-range enum.

The HANDLE_UNKNOWN_OPCODES retry path bypasses the parser's 'all mandatory operands present' gate, so FriendlyNameMapper::ParseInstruction is dispatched on an instruction whose inst.num_words == 3, then the OpTypePointer arm unconditionally reads inst.words[3].

The vulnerable code at source/name_mapper.cpp:264-269:
  case spv::Op::OpTypePointer:
    SaveName(result_id, std::string("_ptr_") +
                            NameForEnumOperand(SPV_OPERAND_TYPE_STORAGE_CLASS,
                                               inst.words[2]) +
                            "_" + NameForId(inst.words[3]));   // <-- OOB read
    break;

OpTypePointer's SPIR-V grammar defines three operands: IdResult, StorageClass, and IdRef Type. A valid encoding has num_words == 4 (1 header + 3 operands). When the malformed instruction declares num_words == 3 and the StorageClass is rejected by the unknown-fallback path, reading inst.words[3] walks past the end of the caller's uint32_t[].
